name: Velocore ConstantProductPool fee underflow
summary: ConstantProductPool.velocore__execute() lacked the vault-only authorization required for its state-changing accounting. The attacker called it directly three times with extreme signed amounts to corrupt feeMultiplier; subsequent Vault.execute() calls reached unchecked effective-fee arithmetic that underflowed and returned invalid pool deltas, draining seven pools in the selected transaction.
notes: The directly deployed ConstantProductPool retained the same 17,153-byte runtime through the exploit.

Verichains and Zokyo report approximately $6.8 million lost across the coherent Velocore campaign on Linea and zkSync. The selected Linea transaction drains seven pools and directly records, among the multi-asset proceeds, 632,705.032352 USDC transferred from the Velocore Vault to the attack contract. The reported cross-chain total is retained without pretending that this one stablecoin component represents the campaign loss.

The $6.8 million gross loss is a rounded reported campaign estimate across Linea and zkSync; the selected Linea transaction's multi-asset proceeds were checked onchain, but the record does not assign incident-time USD prices to every token component.
Not the knot: sibling instance of the same template and failure; target-6 carries the latest age reset and supplies the incident's single observation.
